definition: Renter-occupied housing units as a percentage of all occupied housing units
geography: ZCTA, joined to health ZIP by same five-digit code
period_assessment: 2022 inputs largely postdate the 2008-2018 health target
interpretation_caveat: Measures housing tenure, not percentage of residents renting or air-conditioning access

definition: Occupied housing units with no vehicle available as a percentage of all occupied housing units
geography: ZCTA, joined to health ZIP by same five-digit code
period_assessment: 2022 inputs largely postdate the 2008-2018 health target
interpretation_caveat: Includes owner and renter households; does not measure residents without a driving license or actual center travel time

definition: Percent uninsured in the civilian noninstitutionalized population
formula: S2701_C05_001E (published percentage; do not multiply by 100)
geography: ZCTA, joined to health ZIP by same five-digit code
period_assessment: 2022 inputs largely postdate the 2008-2018 health target
interpretation_caveat: Population universe excludes institutionalized people and active-duty military; it is not a household percentage or a direct heat-exposure measure

definition: Construction-industry employment as a percentage of civilian employed residents age 16 and over
denominator: Civilian employed population 16 years and over
geography: ZCTA, joined to health ZIP by same five-digit code
period_assessment: 2022 inputs largely postdate the 2008-2018 health target
interpretation_caveat: Industry is different from occupation; covers resident workers, not jobs located in the ZIP; imperfect proxy for outdoor work
